note: The Chrome Web Store screenshot candidates, and where each one came from. Every image in this folder except the promo tile is generated from these entries by tools/build-store-assets.py, which letterboxes a capture from docs/screenshots into a 1280x800 frame and draws the caption into it. Text inside a screenshot is a claim about the package, so a capture is only eligible here if nothing in it is contradicted by the build it will be submitted with; the excluded list says why the obvious ones are not here yet. tools/test-store-assets.js fails the gate if this folder and this file disagree.
